title: Rav Landau Slams Draft Law
body: Rav Dov Landau, rosh yeshiva of Slabdoka, spoke out against Israel's draft law, calling it a threat to the Torah world. He addressed hundreds of talmidim at a Chanukah gathering, urging them to stand strong against growing pressure.

title: Har Nof Techias Hameisim
body: Rav Moshe's Har Nof home is a hub for visitors, but one guest has captured the community's attention: a doctor declared dead who's now recovering from a miraculous techias hameisim.
